verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a business banking and financial platform, so automated deposit sweeps for extended FDIC coverage is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions FDIC insurance, partner-bank sweep networks, or automatic deposit allocation. Transfers and batch transfers to your own bank accounts are user-initiated payouts, an adjacent feature that does not deliver automatic sweeps.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have deposits automatically swept across partner banks to maximize FDIC insurance coverage
